skill.name: chatgpt-app-builder
skill.description: Build ChatGPT Apps with phased guidance for product fit, MCP server design, widget development, testing, deployment, and App Store preparation.
skill.summary: Guides developers from ChatGPT App idea to MCP server, widget, testing, and submission readiness.
skill.author: BayramAnnakov

security_audit.summary: AI review found that most static findings are documentation snippets, TypeScript template literals, fixed scaffold paths, and safe SSRF blocklist checks rather than malicious behavior. One semantic issue remains: the sample MCP server uses wildcard CORS on SSE and message endpoints, which should be restricted before production. No prompt injection attempt was found in the reviewed source.

remediation.suggestion: Replace * with explicit allowed origins such as ChatGPT and configured app domains, and reject unexpected Origin headers on /mcp and /mcp/messages.
Require developers to set trusted API_BASE_URL and API_TOKEN through deployment secrets, and document that the token is sent only to the configured backend.
Keep unsafe snippets clearly labeled as examples to avoid, and separate them from production scaffold files where possible.

content.user_title: Build ChatGPT Apps with Apps SDK
content.value_statement: Developers need a clear path from product idea to a working ChatGPT App. This skill provides phased guidance, server and widget templates, testing steps, and submission checks.
actual_capabilities: Evaluate product fit with Know, Do, and Show criteria.
Draft an app specification with tools, widgets, authentication, and golden prompts.
Scaffold a Node MCP server with SSE transport, resources, tools, and widget assets.
Apply React widget patterns, CSS guidance, loading states, and UI token practices.
Guide local testing with MCP Inspector, ngrok, and a ChatGPT connector.
Prepare submission checks for privacy pages, terms pages, challenge endpoints, and production readiness.
limitations: Requires Node.js, npm, and developer access to the target product API.
Generated scaffolds need real API endpoints, authentication, and production secrets.
Does not submit an app to OpenAI or guarantee App Store approval.
The included server scaffold needs CORS hardening before production deployment.

use_cases.title: Validate an App Idea
use_cases.description: Assess whether a product has enough data, actions, or visual value for a ChatGPT App.

use_cases.title: Build an MCP Prototype
use_cases.description: Create a Node MCP server, define tools, and connect a widget to structured tool output.

use_cases.title: Prepare for Review
use_cases.description: Check testing, security, privacy, terms, and deployment requirements before marketplace submission.

prompt_templates.title: Evaluate Product Fit
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the ChatGPT App Builder skill to evaluate my product for a ChatGPT App. Ask for missing context, then apply Know, Do, and Show criteria.

prompt_templates.title: Create an App Specification
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me write app-spec.md for my ChatGPT App. Include tools, widget needs, authentication, golden prompts, and submission risks.

prompt_templates.title: Implement the Prototype
prompt_templates.prompt: Using my app-spec.md, scaffold a Node MCP server and React widget. Keep tool schemas strict and explain each file I should review.

prompt_templates.title: Harden for Production
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit my ChatGPT App implementation for production readiness. Focus on OAuth, CORS, rate limits, privacy pages, terms pages, and App Store submission checks.

output_examples.input: Evaluate whether my task manager should become a ChatGPT App.
output_examples.output: A fit assessment with strengths, blockers, required data, likely tools, widget needs, and recommended next steps.

output_examples.input: Design the tools and widget for a CRM ChatGPT App.
output_examples.output: A concise specification covering read and write tools, input fields, output structure, widget layout, and authentication requirements.

output_examples.input: Help me test my app before submission.
output_examples.output: A testing plan for local MCP Inspector checks, ngrok connector setup, golden prompts, mobile widget review, and submission readiness.

best_practices: Start with product fit before generating server or widget code.
Keep each MCP tool focused on one clear user action.
Replace placeholders and harden CORS, authentication, and secrets before deployment.
anti_patterns: Building a widget before defining tool outputs and user workflows.
Shipping example API tokens, placeholder domains, or permissive CORS settings.
Using broad tool descriptions that trigger for unrelated ChatGPT prompts.

faq.question: What does this skill help me build?
faq.answer: It helps you plan, scaffold, test, and prepare ChatGPT Apps that use the Apps SDK and MCP.

faq.question: Does it write production-ready code automatically?
faq.answer: It provides strong scaffolds and guidance, but developers must connect real APIs and harden production settings.

faq.question: Which tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Does it include widget guidance?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes React widget templates, CSS patterns, loading patterns, UI tokens, and testing guidance.

faq.question: Can it help with authentication?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes OAuth integration guidance and production token storage recommendations.

faq.question: What should I review before deployment?
faq.answer: Review API credentials, CORS origins, OAuth storage, rate limits, privacy pages, terms pages, and submission endpoints.
